mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, AVG(t.arrive_minutes) AS avgResponseMinutes, AVG(t.handle_minutes) AS avgHandleMinutes, AVG(e.score) AS avgScore, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT l.ticket_id) FROM ticket_log l JOIN ticket t2 ON t2.id = l.ticket_id WHERE l.action IN ('ACCEPT_TIMEOUT', 'PROCESS_TIMEOUT', 'AUTO_CLOSE') AND t2.deleted = 0 AND t2.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t2.submit_time >= #{start} AND t2.submit_time < #{end}) AS timeoutCount FROM ticket t LEFT JOIN ticket_evaluation e ON e.ticket_id = t.id WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.submit_time >= #{start} AND t.submit_time < #{end}

SELECT t.worker_id AS workerId, COALESCE(u.real_name, '未知') AS workerName, SUM(CASE WHEN t.finish_time IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS finishedCount, AVG(t.handle_minutes) AS avgHandleMinutes, SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ticket_log l WHERE l.ticket_id = t.id AND l.action = 'PROCESS_TIMEOUT' ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS processTimeoutCount FROM ticket t JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.worker_id WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.worker_id IS NOT NULL AND t.submit_time >= #{start} AND t.submit_time < #{end} GROUP BY t.worker_id, u.real_name ORDER BY finishedCount DESC, t.worker_id
